# Generic liquid-PDMS/silicone optical-coupling RINDEX approximation, NOT raw digitized data.
# Primary source: T. Roychowdhury et al., Surface Science Spectra 25, 026001 (2018),
# DOI 10.1116/1.5046735. Two commercial liquid PDMS samples were measured over 191-1688 nm;
# reported MSA anchors: n(300 nm)=1.443, n(500 nm)=1.407, n(1000 nm)=1.393.
# This file is a 3-term Cauchy interpolation constrained to those anchors.
